name: Museum Where Shadows Become Animals
description: A quiet museum room casts large animal shadows on the walls while the display cases contain only simple geometric objects.
prompt: A single surreal museum interior with polished floors and display cases. Soft light projects large animal shadows on the walls—a deer, a whale, a bird, a fox—while the objects inside remain simple geometric forms. Mysterious, elegant, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: What if the shadows remembered what the objects forgot?
